breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the mass/volume conservation violation at all. It does not point out that Q_in must equal Q_out for steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe, nor does it correct the erroneous outlet flow rate of 0.02 m³/s. Instead, it merely asks for the cross-sectional area, completely ignoring the fundamental physics error in the prompt.
